_comment: epic-cards tool spec. Edit to match your target system's labels. 'filter' = labels every epic must carry to appear on a card (comma tokens; a trailing '*' is a scope wildcard, e.g. mission-thread::* matches any mission-thread::… label).
_taxonomy_comment: 'taxonomy' classifies an epic's unscoped labels: 'bucket' names become the chip row (add 'ALL' for the single-chip shorthand); 'project' names become the Related Systems list. Both 'bucket' and 'project' are EXPLICIT WHITELISTS — only the exact unscoped labels you list here are classified; every other unscoped label on an epic (lifecycle tags, workflow states, ad-hoc labels) is ignored and never shown. WILDCARDS ARE NOT SUPPORTED in the taxonomy — the '*' scope wildcard works only in 'filter'. Enumerate the real bucket and system/group names.
